about: First Esdras tells how God's people came home and rebuilt the temple, and how a young man named Zerubbabel praised the truth.

pages.title: What Is Strongest?
pages.scene: Three young guards talking before King Darius
pages.text: Three young guards of King Darius had a contest: what is the strongest thing? One said wine. One said the king. Young Zerubbabel said, "Truth is strongest of all!" Everyone cheered. The king let him go home to rebuild God's city.

pages.title: Building Again
pages.scene: People cheering at the new temple foundation
pages.text: God's people went home to Jerusalem. They laid the new temple's foundation. The priests blew trumpets, and everyone sang, "God is good! His love lasts forever!" Some shouted for joy and some cried happy tears.
